store.name: Northwind Coffee Co.
store.story: Northwind started in 2016 with one 5kg drum roaster in a Portland garage and a standing order from the cafe across the street. We still roast in small batches to order, still buy from the same six farms and cooperatives, and still ship the day we roast.

products.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
products.description: Washed Yirgacheffe from the Kochere district, 1,900-2,100m. Bergamot and jasmine up front, a clean lemon acidity, and a tea-like finish. Our lightest roast — best as a pour-over, and worth a coarser grind than you think.

products.name: Colombia Huila
products.description: From smallholder farms around Pitalito in Huila, fully washed and dried on raised beds. Soft caramel sweetness, red apple, and enough body to hold up in milk. The one to buy if you only buy one.

products.name: Sumatra Mandheling
products.description: Wet-hulled in the Lintong highlands, which is what gives it that unmistakable cedar-and-earth depth. Syrupy body, almost no acidity, and it stays bold through milk or a long brew.

products.name: Northwind Espresso
products.description: Our house blend and the coffee we drink most: Brazilian pulped natural for chocolate and body, washed Colombian for a bright edge. Built for 18g in, 36g out in 25-30 seconds, and forgiving if you are a second off.

products.name: Midnight Decaf
products.description: Decaffeinated with sugarcane ethyl acetate in Colombia, which keeps far more of the cup than a solvent wash. Cocoa, dried plum and a gentle sweetness — a real coffee that happens to be decaf.

products.name: Roaster's Sampler
products.description: Four 100g bags of whatever came off the roaster this week, with tasting notes and brew ratios on each. The easiest way to find your coffee, and the gift we send most.

policies.shipping: Orders roasted and dispatched within one business day. Standard delivery 2-4 business days, $5. Free over $40. Express next-day $12, ordered before 11:00. We ship to the US and Canada.
policies.returns: Unopened bags can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. If a bag is opened and you are not happy with the coffee, tell us within 14 days of delivery and we replace it or refund it - no need to send it back.
policies.subscription: Pick your beans and a cadence of 2, 4 or 6 weeks. Subscriptions save 15% and ship free. Pause, skip, swap beans or cancel any time before the next roast date.
policies.brewing: Use about 1:16 coffee to water - roughly 15g coffee to 250g water. Brew between 195 and 205F. A pour-over takes 3-4 minutes total, with a 30-45 second bloom first.

testimonials.name: Marta Køhler
testimonials.quote: The Espresso blend is the only coffee my machine has never fought me on. Four years, same bag, every four weeks.

testimonials.name: Devon Aluko
testimonials.quote: They roast on Tuesday and it is on my bar Thursday. Nobody else I have worked with is that consistent about the date on the bag.

testimonials.name: Priya Raghavan
testimonials.quote: I had no idea what I liked. The sampler sorted that out in a fortnight and I have been on the Yirgacheffe ever since.

faq.q: How fresh is the coffee when it arrives?
faq.a: It is roasted the day it ships, and the roast date is printed on every bag. Rest it three to five days, then use it within four weeks.
Either — choose at checkout and we grind to your method. Whole bean keeps better, so it is what we send unless you tell us otherwise.

faq.q: Do you ship outside the US?
faq.a: Canada, yes. Nowhere else yet: we would rather not send coffee somewhere it arrives stale.

faq.q: What if I do not like it?
faq.a: Tell us within 14 days of delivery and we replace it or refund it, and you keep the bag. We would rather find you the right coffee than argue about a return.
Any time before the next roast date, from the account page or by asking the assistant. No notice period, no fee.
No. Northwind Coffee is a demonstration store for Busymate AI: real catalogue, real policies, real assistant — no orders, no payments, no real customers.
